PROJECT TITLE

Simple Multi-User Garment Shop Billing & Estimate Android App (APK)

BUSINESS PROCESS

A customer may select products from multiple salesmen in the store.

Each salesman should be able to create or update his own product selections against a common Estimate Number.

The estimate should be visible instantly to all salesmen, managers and owner.

At the billing counter, the cashier can view all products added by different salesmen, modify if required, print estimate and generate final GST bill.

IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS

1. User Roles

A. Salesman
• Can create new estimate.
• Can open existing estimate.
• Can add products only under his own Salesman ID.
• Can edit only his own entries.

B. Manager/Cashier
• Can view all estimates.
• Can edit any salesman's entries.
• Can add/delete products.
• Can print estimate.
• Can generate final GST bill.

C. Owner/Admin
• Full access to all data.
• View sales reports.
• View salesman commission reports.
• User management.

LOGIN

• Login credentials should remain saved on device.
• User should only press Login button.
• Minimum clicks required.
• Online synchronization between all users.

Salesman X creates Estimate No. EST0056

Salesman X enters:

400_wala × 5 = ₹2,000

500_wala × 6 = ₹3,000

Customer moves to Salesman Y.

Salesman Y opens EST0056 and enters:

350_wala × 8 = ₹2,800

250_wala × 10 = ₹2,500

Salesman X

400_wala × 5 = ₹2,000

500_wala × 6 = ₹3,000

Salesman Y

350_wala × 8 = ₹2,800

250_wala × 10 = ₹2,500

Cashier can:

• Add products

₹50_wala
₹100_wala
₹150_wala
₹200_wala

and continue in multiples of ₹50 up to ₹2,000.

Click 1:
Login

Click 2:
New Estimate
or
Open Estimate

Click 3:
Select Product Price from dropdown

Click 4:
Enter Quantity

Click 5:
Next Product dropdown automatically appears

• Can be entered later at billing counter.
• Name
• Mobile Number
• GST Details (optional)

COMMISSION SYSTEM

Commission = ₹25

• Date Range

• Cloud database
• Fast operation
• Offline caching if possible
• Android APK

1. Daily Sales Report
2. Monthly Sales Report
3. Estimate Report
4. Salesman Commission Report
5. User-wise Sales Report

UI REQUIREMENT

• Very simple design
• Large buttons
• Minimum clicks
• Fast product entry
• Mobile-first interface

• Source Code

• Installation Guide

## Project Overview

I am looking for an experienced n8n developer to build a production-ready AI Sales Agent for my WooCommerce ecommerce business.

The AI should handle customer conversations across multiple channels, search real WooCommerce products, answer company FAQs using a knowledge base, log leads, and hand off conversations to human staff when needed.

This is not a simple chatbot project. I need a practical AI sales automation system connected to WooCommerce and a RAG knowledge base.

## Channels

The system should support:

* Facebook Messenger
* Viber
* Telegram
* TikTok
* Website Chat

Messages from all channels should be processed through one centralized AI workflow and replied back on the original platform.

---

## Core Features

### 1. AI Sales Assistant

The AI should understand customer intent such as:

* Product search
* Price inquiry
* Stock inquiry
* Product recommendation
* Product comparison
* Delivery questions
* Payment questions
* Warranty / return policy
* Technical service inquiries
* Order status inquiries
* Human staff requests

The AI must not invent product information. If data is unavailable, it should escalate to staff.

---

### 2. WooCommerce Integration

The AI must search real WooCommerce product data.

Required fields:

* Product Name
* SKU
* Variation SKU
* Product Type
* Price
* Sale Price
* Stock Status
* Stock Quantity
* Product Image
* Product URL
* Category
* Product Attributes

Important:

My store contains many variable products.

The system must support variation-level search, including SKU, stock, price, and attributes.

---

### 3. Product Recommendations

Example:

Customer: "I need an Arduino board for beginners."

The AI should:

* Search products
* Recommend suitable items
* Show price
* Show stock
* Provide product links
* Explain why the product is suitable

---

### 4. RAG Knowledge Base

The AI should answer company questions using a knowledge base.

Examples:

* Delivery policy
* Payment methods
* Warranty policy
* Return policy
* Reseller policy
* Technical services
* FAQ

Preferred solutions:

* Google Drive
* Supabase
* PostgreSQL + pgvector
* Qdrant

The knowledge base should be easy for non-technical staff to update.

---

### 5. CRM / Lead Logging

Store customer information such as:

* Name
* Phone
* Platform
* Conversation
* Interested Product
* Lead Status
* Conversation Summary
* Date & Time

Preferred:

* Airtable
* Google Sheets
* Supabase

---

### 6. Human Handoff

The AI must notify staff when:

* Product information is unavailable
* Customer requests discounts
* Customer complaints occur
* Customer sends payment proof
* Technical questions are too complex
* AI confidence is low

Preferred notification methods:

* Telegram
* Airtable
* Google Sheets

---

### 7. Language Support

The system must support:

* English
* Burmese (Myanmar)
* Mixed Burmese + English messages

---

## Tech Stack

Required:

* n8n
* DeepSeek or OpenAI API
* WooCommerce API
* WordPress
* Facebook API
* Viber API
* Telegram API
* TikTok API

Preferred:

* PostgreSQL

* Airtable
* Google Sheets

* Setup documentation
* API configuration guide
* WooCommerce integration
* Variable product support
* Knowledge base setup
* CRM integration
* Human handoff workflow
* Testing results
* Training video
* Maintenance instructions

---

## Important Requirements

The AI must:

* Never invent stock
* Never invent prices
* Never invent company policies
* Use WooCommerce as the source of truth
* Use the knowledge base for company information
* Escalate to human staff when uncertain

---
